00051 class UGenOutput
00052 {
00053 public:
00054   UGenOutput() throw();
00055   ~UGenOutput();
00056   
00057   inline void prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize)
00058   {
00059     ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00060     
00061     if(externalOutput != 0)
00062     {     
00063       externalOutput->prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize);
00064       blockSize = externalOutput->getBlockSize();
00065       block = externalOutput->getSampleData();
00066     }
00067     else if(!usingExternalOutput)
00068     {
00069       blockSize = actualBlockSize;
00070       
00071       if(actualBlockSize > allocatedBlockSize)
00072       {   
00073         delete [] block;
00074         allocatedBlockSize = blockSize;
00075         block = new float[allocatedBlockSize];
00076       }
00077     }
00078   }
00079   //void optimiseBlockSize(); // reduce block sizes to minimum
00080   
00081   inline int getBlockSize() const           { return blockSize;     }
00082   inline float* getSampleData() const         { return block;       }
00083   inline void zeroAllData()             { memset(block, 0, blockSize * sizeof(float)); }
00084   void initValue(const float value) throw();
00085   
00086   void useExternalOutput(UGenOutput* externalOutputToUse);
00087   void useExternalOutput(float* externalOutputToUse, const int externalBlockSize);
00088   
00089 private:
00090   int blockSize;
00091   int allocatedBlockSize;
00092   float *block;
00093   bool usingExternalOutput:1;
00094   UGenOutput* externalOutput;
00095 };
